content: {"paper_id":"W4416017689","annotations":[{"keyword_id":"multi-label-learning","exact_quote":"Multi-label learning focuses on tasks where each instance is associated with multiple labels.","evidence_field":"abstract","reason_zh":"摘要首句定义每个实例关联多个标签，论文整体研究多标记学习任务。"},{"keyword_id":"noisy-label-learning","exact_quote":"Noisy multi-label learning has hence been studied to address the label noise problem.","evidence_field":"abstract","reason_zh":"论文以多标记数据中的标签噪声问题为研究条件，并针对实例相关噪声提出鲁棒学习框架。"},{"keyword_id":"weakly-supervised-learning","exact_quote":"Due to the high cost of obtaining accurate annotations, real-world multi-label datasets often contain noisy labels from crowdsourcing or automated annotation.","evidence_field":"abstract","reason_zh":"以不准确或不完整标注替代充分准确的实例级真值，并将标签噪声作为实质研究问题。"},{"keyword_id":"low-rank-modeling","exact_quote":"via a joint low-rank and sparse decomposition","evidence_field":"abstract","reason_zh":"对观测标签矩阵显式使用联合低秩与稀疏分解，属于低秩建模。"},{"keyword_id":"data-imputation-recovery","exact_quote":"RIDE first decomposes the observed label matrix into clean and noisy components via a joint low-rank and sparse decomposition.","evidence_field":"abstract","reason_zh":"从受噪声污染的观测标签矩阵中分解出干净分量，属于从污染观测恢复原始标签的数据恢复任务。"}],"abstentions":[{"keyword_id":"label-correlation-modeling","reason_zh":"低秩分解标签矩阵可能隐含标签相关结构，但摘要未显式说明建模标签间共现、依赖或排序关系，证据不足。"},{"keyword_id":"sparse-representation","reason_zh":"摘要中的稀疏分解与稀疏正则主要作用于噪声矩阵或映射矩阵，未明确以少量字典原子或基向量表达样本；定义明确单独对噪声稀疏惩罚不充分。"}],"input_issues":[]}
